name: Spiral staircase
notes: Rise 3.0 m, 16 risers of 187.5 mm: 15 wedge treads plus the landing. Pole on the origin. Size Y is the bounding height including the handrail above the upper floor.
parts: black steel center pole with base flange and cap
15 oak wedge treads with nosing, 26 degrees apart
oak landing sector at the upper floor
round steel balusters, two per tread
style: black powder-coat steel, oak treads and handrail
summary: Spiral staircase, 1.6 m diameter, 3.0 m rise: steel center pole with spacers, 15 oak wedge treads, landing, steel balusters, helical oak handrail.
